title: What a business is

draft.title: What a business is
card: A business is an organisation that provides goods or services to customers. Goods are things such as bread, and services are actions such as a haircut.
To do this, a business brings together resources: people, money, materials, equipment and premises (the buildings it works from).
Most businesses aim to make a profit. This means earning more money than they spend, which rewards the owners.

Not-for-profit organisations, such as charities and many sports clubs, also use resources to serve people. Their main aim is not profit for owners, as any money left over goes back into their cause. This course is about businesses.
draft.remember: A business combines resources to supply customers, usually aiming for profit.

a.q: Which description best fits a business?
opts: Uses resources to supply customers, usually for a profit
Uses donations to give free help to people in need
Buys goods and services for its own members to use
Collects taxes to pay for public services like schools
a.why: A business brings together resources to provide goods or services to customers, and most aim for a profit. Using donations to help people describes a charity, a not-for-profit organisation whose main aim is not profit for owners.
a.clue: Think about who the organisation supplies and what it usually aims for.

b.q: A surf club in Byron Bay sells memberships and runs a canteen. Money left over is spent on rescue gear. Why is it a not-for-profit?
opts: Its main aim is not to earn a profit for owners
It provides a service rather than physical goods
It does not need money or other resources
It has no people that it serves or supplies
b.why: The club spends any money left over on its cause, rescue gear, rather than paying it to owners. That is what makes it a not-for-profit. Providing a service does not decide it, because businesses can sell goods, services or both.
b.clue: Ask where the leftover money goes.

a.best: Uses resources to supply customers, usually for a profit

b.best: Its main aim is not to earn a profit for owners
